import Mathlib

theorem p05 : ¬ ∃ q : ℚ, q * q = 2 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hq_real : (q : ℝ) * q = 2 := by
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have hq_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (q : ℝ)]
  have hq_eq : (q : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    nlinarith [
      Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num),
      Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 : ℝ)
    ]
  exact (irrational_sqrt_two q) hq_eq
